description: A dc_api request naming a response_uri (or a redirect_uri) refuses: the Digital Credentials API channel's answer returns through the browser, never a wallet-side POST (OpenID4VP 1.0 §8.4).
spec_refs: OpenID4VP 1.0 section 8.4 (the Digital Credentials API response modes: no wallet-side POST)
OpenID4VP 1.0 section 5 (response_uri belongs to the direct_post channel)
notes: The channel-fault refusal: a request that mixes the channels — the dc_api response mode with a direct_post response_uri — never presents. Suite-adjacent on 2026-11-09: the dc_api group's parse-level refusals all answer the flow error (plan t8zTXhIGHDy25); this exact fault is the §8.4 rule the group's happy paths prove by their absence of any POST.
